senses.gloss:
Uddyota
name of several C.s.
--of a.. C. on Sampatkarīsaṁvitstuticarcā, TCD. 1127A.
--of C. by Āśādhara on Aṣṭāṅgahṛdaya, Peters. II. 86.
--of C. by Nāgeśa on Mahābhāṣyapradīpa of Kaiyaṭa.
--of C. by Nāgojibhaṭṭa on Kāvyapradīpa of Govinda.
--of C. by Puruṣottama Tarkālaṅkāra on the Amarakośa.
--of C. by Bhairavadatta on Parāśara's Uḍudāyapradīpa. jy.
--of a C. on Kāvyaprakāśa. Q. by Ratnakaṇṭha in his K. pra. sārasamuccaya. Peters. II. 17.
--of a modern C. on Kāvyaprakāśa. Calcutta Ed.. of 1866. p.. 230. 287.

Uddyota
dh. See Ācāroddyota, Prāyaścittoddyota, Samayoddyota.

Uddyota
dh. authority q. by Jīmūtavāhana in his Dāyabhāga (see Maheśvara Bhaṭṭācārya's C. on Dāyabhāga, II. 9). See JASB. (NS) XI (1915) 320.

Uddyotakara_Bhagavadbhāradvāja_Nyāyācārya
ref. to also a. Pāśupatācārya. Earlier part of 7th cent. A. D.; mentions an. criticises Bud. a.s an. works, Vasubandhu, Diṅnāga, Vādavidhi an. Vādavidhānaṭīkā. [Page337-b] Q. by Dharmakīrti in his Vādanyāya. On Uddyotakara's treatment of Vaiśeṣika topics, see Proceed. AIOC. XV. p.. 327-334.
--Nyāyasūtrabhāṣyavārttika.
Ed.. Kasi Skt. Ser. 33. 1916.

Uddyotakara
Q. by Subhūticandra in his C. on Amarakośa. See JOR. Madras, VIII. 373.

Uddyotakara
--C. on Meghadūta. Q. by Kalyāṇamalla on Meghadūta, 47.

Uddyotacandra
disciple of Lakṣmīpati (a. of Māyāmukhyakārikā. adv., Bikaner 6520).

Uddyotacandrikā
See Bhāṭṭasārasarvasvoddyotacandrikā. Baroda 12957 (inc.).

Uddyotana
gr. name of C. by Annaṁbhaṭṭa on Mahābhāṣyapradīpa of Kaiyaṭa. MT. 2038 (inc.).

Uddyotanasūri
Jain. in civil life Dākṣiṇyacihna, a Kṣatriya, son of Vaṭeśvara alias Samprati; pupil of Haribhadra an. Nemicandra; composed Kuvalayamālākathā in 779 A. D. a. Jhālor in Marwar in the time of Vatsarāja of the Pratīhāras.
--Kuvalayamālā-kathā.
Ed.. Singhi Jain. Ser. 45. 1959. See also Apabhraṁśakāvyatrayī, GOS. 37, Skt. Intro. p.. 89-94; Bhāratīya Vidyā II. i. p.. 77-88.

Uddyotanasūri
Jain. Saṁ. 994; started numerous Gacchas: mentioned a. guru of several, e.g. Āmradeva, Sarvadeva, Vardhamana (Kharatara). Pupil or successor of Nemicandra, Vimalacandra etc. See BBRAS. 1639. BORI. D. XVII. i. 17. 382. Peters. III. App. p.. 68. 314. IV. p. 69. Weber II. p.. 1004, 1035. Ind. Ant. XI. p.. 248, 252. [Page338-a.

Uddyotanasūri
preceptor of Yaśodevasūri (a. of Pāriṭhāsaṁṭhiaṇa, Peters. I. App. p. 98).

Uddyotapañcamīstuti
Jain. BORI. 1172 of 1884-87 (with C.). BORI. D. XIX. i. 35. ii. 706 (34a).
--C. Vṛtti by Kanakakuśala Gaṇi, pupil of Somakuśala. BORI. 1172 of 1884-87 (with text). BORI. D. XIX. i. 35.
Pt.. a. Jñānapañcamīstuti in Stutisaṅgraha (p.. 53a-56b) by Yaśovijaya Jaina Saṁskṛta Pāṭhaśālā, Mhesana, A. D. 1912.

Udyaddantajananaśānti
prayoga. MD. 14439.

Udyadbhūṣaṇa
one of the six sons of Govindabhaṭṭa an. brother of Hastimalla (Vikrāntakaurava, MT. 1334). Praśastisaṅgraha p. 162.
Same a. Udayabhūṣaṇa above.

Udyannadyamantra
(Ṛv. I. 50. 11) on its use a. a prāyaścitta acc. to Bodhāyana, IO. 4820.

Udyānaguṇavacanamañjarī
mentioned in the Dṛṣtāntasiddhāñjana, a C. by Kallolabhaṭṭācārya on his grandfather Sujana's lexicon Śabdaliṅgārthacandrikā. See Adyar Library Bulletin VII. p. 41, Mss. notes.

Udyānapratiṣṭhā
dh. Gov. Or. Libr. Madras 12. MD. 3254.

Udyāpana
dh. CPB. 510.

Udyāpanakālanirṇaya
dh. Burnell 147a.

Udyāpanapratiṣṭhāvidhi
Rajapur 943.

Udyāpanavidhāna
Oppert I. 4392.

Udyāpanavidhi
Ānandāśrama 5880 (Yājñika). Burnell 144b. CPB. 511 (dh.). IIO. Stein 225 (vidhayaH). RASB. III. 2979. Vidyāraṇyapura 88.

Udyāpanasūtra
ref. to in Aśvatthodyāpanaprayoga, Bomb. Uni. 1217.

Udyogalalitāpūjana
Bharatpur I. 432.

Udyogasāra
Jain. Moodbidri II. 481 (b).

Udyogasāracaritra
Jain. Moodbidri II. 403 (a.. [Page342-a.
